thread:
sophie: Quick sync after the PM: vendor auth outage + model-registry retries. Need concrete owners, short deadlines, and a recurrence rule. We had two similar auth blips in 60 days; want to make this stick.

raj: I'll own the auth-side playbook and the immediate mitigation (token caching + sticky sessions). Plan: short spike to validate sticky tokens for 48h, then implement reissue backfill.

maria: I'll take model-registry resiliency: durable webhook buffering, better retry policy (exp backoff + capped jitter), and idempotency enforcement. Also propose an S3 cold-store for missed events.

li: I'll coordinate vendor SLA follow-up and get an engineering contact on their side. Need to gather exact failure windows and request a post-incident RCA.

jordan: I'll run a routing fallback exercise: verify automatic tier downgrade to small-quantized model when upstream control-plane errors spike. Add smoke tests for fallback correctness.

elaine: I'll keep the incident tracker up to date and own verification checks before we close items. Please add measurable acceptance criteria.

devsec-bot: Created tickets: INC-4690 (raj) auth-sticky-token-mitigation, INC-4691 (maria) model-registry-queue.

sophie: Mitigation notes for spike: set TTL cache size to 10k, sticky_period = 3600s, and canary to 2% traffic. Example env snippet:
```bash
AUTH_CACHE_SIZE=10000
STICKY_TOKEN_TTL=3600
CANARY_PERCENT=2
```

raj: Spike checklist: 1) implement local cache in auth-proxy 2) enable canary via traffic-split 3) monitor key metrics: auth_5xx_rate, webhook_5xx_rate, fallback_rate. Will target a demo by EOD Thursday (first_message_ts + 4d).

maria: For the buffer consumer: design goals: at-least-once + idempotent handlers + DLQ after 5 retries. Risk: event duplication; must surface metrics for dedupe counts. Target PR: 2026-04-12.

li: Vendor ask: collect timestamps, sample request IDs, and provider-side logs for 2026-03-21 02:00-02:30 UTC. I'll escalate to their infra team and request a 5 business-day turnaround.

jordan: Failover test plan: stage run next Tue 08:00-09:00 PT (routing-only), prod dry-run two weeks after. Need platform sign-off.

elaine: Proposed acceptance criteria to add to tracker rows:
- auth mitigation: canary auth_5xx_rate <= 0.1% over 48h and no increased latency (> P95 baseline + 50ms)
- model-registry buffer: end-to-end delivery >= 99.95% on 95th replay traffic
- fallback: routing-only test with <1% error delta compared to baseline

sophie: Also adding a recurrence rule: label as "recurring-pattern" if same vendor-related outage occurs 3x in 90 days. If triggered, escalate to vendor-contract review and exec alert.

raj: I'll include a kill-switch and automated rollback in the feature-flag flow. If auth_5xx_rate increases by >0.3% vs baseline, auto-rollback.

maria: I'll add synthetic replay tests to CI: push 24h of captured staging traffic and validate webhook success and DLQ metrics.

li: I'll prepare the vendor comms draft and share in this thread. Preliminary ask: SLA credits and commitment to fix time windows.

devsec-bot: INC-4690 status -> in progress. INC-4691 status -> in progress. Reminder: owners will receive weekly ping until closed.

elaine: I'll set due dates: INC-4690 spike demo by +4d, full rollout within 8 sprint days after spike. INC-4691 PR by 2026-04-12, deploy by +21d.

sophie: Ownership rotation: if owner is out >72h, assign to oncall. Also propose a fortnightly "dependency hardening" sync on Tuesdays during handoff.

jordan: I'll create the calendar invite and add infra reviewers.

maria: I'll post a short design doc in #eng-ml and link the PR here.

raj: Will post canary dashboard link when live.

elaine: Final check: add test criteria, confirm vendor contact, and ensure ops-bot pings weekly. Reconvene in 2 weeks for status and closure review. :white_check_mark:

devsec-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 14 days (thread pinned).
